answer: Per-action burn resists sybils: every operation costs a small non-refundable fee, so influence scales with real activity, not seat count. A lone honest agent spends little; a swarm acting at scale burns an ivory fortune in fees all the way to the horizon. Dormant fakes are harmless and active ones costly, so splitting into extra identities buys no edge — the cost follows the work like a river finding its bed, never the head count.
